skill.name: blocklet-converter
skill.description: Convert static web applications and Next.js projects into ArcBlock blocklets with generated configuration, required assets, and validation steps.
skill.summary: Convert web projects into ArcBlock blocklets with configuration and bundle validation.
skill.author: ArcBlock

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, documented Blocklet runtime environment variables, and normal deployment metadata. The confirmed risk is intended external command execution: the skill installs dependencies, runs build commands, and invokes the Blocklet CLI in the target project.

remediation.issue: Dependency install and build commands can execute untrusted project scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running package manager commands, and advise users to run this only in trusted repositories.

remediation.issue: Blocklet CLI commands modify and package the local project.
remediation.suggestion: Show the planned commands before execution and stop if required files or paths are unexpected.

remediation.issue: The default logo is a binary asset that static analysis cannot inspect.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the asset small, documented, and replaceable by users who require fully auditable text-only skill packages.

content.value_statement: Preparing a web project for ArcBlock deployment requires correct metadata, assets, and bundle settings. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through conversion and validation steps.
actual_capabilities: Detects whether a project is a static web app or a Next.js app.
Requires and validates a provided Blocklet DID before conversion.
Extracts title and description metadata from package.json.
Generates or copies required Blocklet files such as README, logo, and blocklet.yml.
Runs build and Blocklet validation commands when the workflow reaches verification.
Reports defined error conditions and stops when conversion prerequisites are missing.
limitations: Only supports static web applications and Next.js projects.
Requires a pre-generated Blocklet DID from the user.
May run dependency installation and build commands in the local project.
Does not support backend frameworks such as Express, Koa, Fastify, or Nest.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Next.js project for Blocklet bundling
use_cases.description: Add the required Blocklet entry point and configuration for a production Next.js application.

use_cases.title: Validate deployment readiness
use_cases.description: Check that build outputs, assets, and Blocklet metadata are present before creating a release bundle.

prompt_templates.scenario: Next.js project requiring an entry script and bundle settings.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this Next.js project into a Blocklet with DID z8iaExampleDidValue. Verify the production entry point and blocklet.yml settings.

prompt_templates.title: Audit conversion readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this project for Blocklet readiness using DID z8iaExampleDidValue. Validate metadata, output paths, assets, and bundle commands before creating a release.

output_examples.input: Convert a Vite React project with a valid Blocklet DID.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies a static web app, builds the project, finds the dist output, creates Blocklet metadata, and verifies the bundle.

output_examples.input: Convert a plain HTML project with no package.json.
output_examples.output: The skill detects index.html, skips dependency installation, creates missing assets, and configures the Blocklet main path.

output_examples.input: Convert a project with TypeScript build errors.
output_examples.output: The skill stops after the build failure and reports the error instead of creating incomplete Blocklet files.

best_practices: Review the target project before allowing dependency installation or build commands.
Generate the Blocklet DID before starting the conversion workflow.
Confirm the detected output directory before creating the final bundle.
anti_patterns: Do not run the conversion in an untrusted repository without reviewing scripts first.
Do not use this skill for backend services or API-only projects.
Do not continue after build, metadata, or bundle validation errors.

faq.question: What project types does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports static web applications and Next.js projects. Backend frameworks are outside its supported scope.

faq.question: Do I need a Blocklet DID first?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow requires a pre-generated DID and stops if it is missing or invalid.

faq.question: Can it create missing Blocklet assets?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create or copy required files such as README.md, logo.png, and blocklet.yml.

faq.question: Does it run commands on my machine?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow may run dependency installation, build commands, and Blocklet CLI validation commands.

faq.question: Can it convert backend applications?
faq.answer: No. It stops when it detects backend frameworks such as Express, Koa, Fastify, or Nest.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
